newsitem.title: USA: Florida child sues church for forced baptism.
newsitem.headline: Florida child sues church for forced baptism.

text.p: An eight-year-old Florida girl is suing a Baptist minister and his church, saying they "intentionally forced baptism upon her, without consent of her parents."

The claim by Sarah Xanders and her mother, Sherry Braithwaite, was filed against the Rev. Lamar Breedlove, pastor of Central Fellowship Baptist Church in Lake Helen, Florida, according to Wednesday's Orlando Sentinel.

The lawsuit seeks a state court jury trial and damages in excess of $15,000. The legal action stems from an Aug. 18 incident in which Sarah and two cousins, aged four and seven, were baptised at the church without their parents' consent during a Bible school class.
Only a 12-year-old cousin agreed to be baptised. The younger children said they were upset when church members told them they must disrobe and be put into water to "save their souls."
"We're interested in shutting the church down so this kind of thing won't happen again," Braithwaite told the Sentinel. "We're not doing this for money."
In recent weeks, a dozen parents have come forward saying their children were baptised under similar conditions. Church officials had no comment on Wednesday.
